title: 1637 Prairie's wing rises to the cornice under its own roof
items: The forward wing on Jesse Spalding's house at 1637 Prairie now rises to the cornice and has its own steep slate roof, as the engraving shows. It used to stop below the cornice under a flat tin deck.
That roof's ridge runs back into the main roof at about the main roof's height, and the wing's chimney stands just beside it.
